reasoning_traces.think:
The Open R1 framework constructs a formalized reasoning pipeline through three core components: (1) Distilled Data Pipeline, which synthesizes high-fidelity reasoning traces from DeepSeek-R1; (2) Multi-Stage Training Framework, which sequentially applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO); and (3) Reasoning Trace Dataset, which encodes step-wise logic for model instruction. These components form an isomorphic mapping to DeepSeek’s R1-Zero architecture, enabling empirical validation of reasoning fidelity. Failure modes include overfitting during SFT, divergence in GRPO, and degradation in trace quality. Dualities emerge between synthetic data generation and empirical benchmarking, with IOI24 and CodeForces-CoTs serving as critical verification metrics.
